source.text_it: Il conducente non può intervenire sul comando della frizione se la stessa è di tipo pneumo-idraulico

records.localized_text: The driver cannot operate a pneumatic-hydraulic clutch control.

source.text_it: Il pedale della frizione può comandare il cuscinetto reggispinta con dispositivi di tipo a vite senza fine

records.localized_text: The clutch pedal may operate the release bearing through worm-screw devices.

source.text_it: Il disco della frizione è collegato permanentemente all'albero secondario del cambio

records.localized_text: The clutch disc is permanently connected to the gearbox output shaft.

source.text_it: Il disco della frizione è collegato permanentemente all'albero ausiliario del cambio

records.localized_text: The clutch disc is permanently connected to the gearbox auxiliary shaft.

source.text_it: Il pedale della frizione comanda i satelliti del differenziale

records.localized_text: The clutch pedal controls the differential satellite gears.

source.text_it: Il ferodo presente sul disco della frizione deve essere periodicamente ingrassato e oliato

records.localized_text: The clutch disc friction lining must be periodically greased and oiled.

source.text_it: Il ferodo presente sul disco della frizione deve essere periodicamente pulito con benzina

records.localized_text: The clutch disc friction lining must be periodically cleaned with petrol.

source.text_it: Periodicamente è necessario ingrassare il disco della frizione

records.localized_text: The clutch disc must be greased periodically.

source.text_it: Periodicamente è necessario allentare le molle dello spingidisco della frizione

records.localized_text: Clutch pressure plate springs must be loosened periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere efficiente la frizione è necessario sostituire l'olio dell'impianto frenante

records.localized_text: To keep the clutch working properly, the braking system oil must be replaced.

source.text_it: Per mantenere efficiente la frizione è necessario sostituire l'olio del motore

records.localized_text: To keep the clutch working properly, the engine oil must be replaced.

source.text_it: Per mantenere efficiente la frizione è necessario controllare il livello dell'olio tramite l'apposita asta graduata

records.localized_text: To keep the clutch working properly, check its oil level with the graduated dipstick.

source.text_it: Il ferodo presente sul disco della frizione non è soggetto a usura

records.localized_text: Clutch disc friction lining is not subject to wear.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo ha la frizione automatica, non è necessario provvedere alla manutenzione della frizione stessa

records.localized_text: An automatic clutch needs no maintenance.

source.text_it: La frizione non ha bisogno di manutenzione in quanto è autoregistrante

records.localized_text: A clutch needs no maintenance because it is self-adjusting.

source.text_it: I veicoli dotati di frizione automatica sono maggiormente soggetti a ribaltamento in curva

records.localized_text: Vehicles with automatic clutches are more prone to overturning on bends.

source.text_it: Il pedale della frizione può essere rilasciato bruscamente dal conducente in fase di partenza

records.localized_text: The driver may release the clutch pedal abruptly when starting.

source.text_it: L'impianto di lubrificazione serve a diminuire l'attrito tra gli organi in movimento del motore e ad evitare il surriscaldamento e l'eventuale grippaggio degli stessi

records.localized_text: The lubrication system reduces friction between moving engine parts and prevents overheating and possible seizure.

source.text_it: In un impianto di lubrificazione, la pompa pesca l'olio dalla coppa e lo invia, tramite apposite scanalature, alle varie parti in movimento del motore

records.localized_text: In a lubrication system, the pump draws oil from the sump and sends it through passages to moving engine parts.

source.text_it: La lubrificazione evita che lo scorrimento tra le superfici a contatto usuri i materiali a contatto

records.localized_text: Lubrication prevents sliding between contacting surfaces from wearing the materials.

source.text_it: La lubrificazione viene garantita dalla presenza di un velo di olio lubrificante tra le superfici

records.localized_text: Lubrication is ensured by a film of lubricating oil between surfaces.

source.text_it: L'impianto di lubrificazione può essere del tipo a circolazione forzata oppure a circolazione naturale

records.localized_text: A lubrication system may use forced or natural circulation.

source.text_it: La pompa di iniezione fa parte del circuito di lubrificazione

records.localized_text: The injection pump is part of the lubrication circuit.

source.text_it: Compito della lubrificazione è aumentare l'attrito, altrimenti le parti meccaniche non potrebbero esercitare la loro funzione

records.localized_text: Lubrication increases friction; otherwise mechanical parts could not function.

source.text_it: Un olio lubrificante deve avere un alto grado di acidità per non formare morchie e patine all’interno dei cilindri

records.localized_text: Lubricating oil must have high acidity to prevent sludge and films forming inside cylinders.

rows.text: The driver can operate the pedal: the hydraulic control transmits the action and compressed air provides assistance.
evidence: https://truck.knorr-bremse.com/en/us/products/drivetrain/clutch-actuation/ — pedal-operated master cylinder and compressed-air booster.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the scope of a worm-gear mechanism is not established. A conventional pedal can operate the release bearing through linkage or hydraulics; that does not prove every other arrangement impossible.
evidence: Official superiori question 29762 retains its printed verdict.
Patent https://patents.google.com/patent/US4445600A/en describes a pedal-related worm for self-adjustment, not proof of direct release-bearing actuation; scope unresolved.

rows.text: The disc hub is connected to the gearbox input shaft, not its output shaft.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/ — disc hub spline fits transmission input shaft.

rows.text: The disc hub is connected to the gearbox input shaft, not an auxiliary shaft.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/ — disc hub spline fits transmission input shaft.

rows.text: The pedal operates the clutch release mechanism, not the differential gears.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — pedal actuation, hydraulic cylinders and self-adjusting wear compensation.

rows.text: The friction material of a dry clutch must be kept free of oil and grease: contamination can cause slipping.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: The friction material does not require periodic cleaning with petrol; if worn or contaminated, the disc and the cause of the fault should be assessed.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: The friction surface of a dry disc is not periodically greased: grease can cause slipping. Lubricating the hub during installation is a separate operation.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.
https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/ — hub splines receive light grease at installation.

rows.text: The springs supply the force that clamps the disc: periodically loosening them is not a maintenance procedure and would reduce clamping force.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: Changing brake fluid maintains the braking system; it is not a general rule for maintaining the clutch. Follow the vehicle’s instructions for any hydraulic clutch control too.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — pedal actuation, hydraulic cylinders and self-adjusting wear compensation.

rows.text: Engine oil lubricates the engine; changing it does not replace clutch-specific checks and repairs.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.
https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: The dipstick checks engine oil, not clutch condition. Check the clutch control according to the vehicle instructions.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.
https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — pedal actuation, hydraulic cylinders and self-adjusting wear compensation.

rows.text: Friction material wears in use; excessive wear can cause slipping.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: Automatic actuation does not eliminate component wear: checks and repairs depend on the system and manufacturer’s instructions.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/health-check-ecolife/ — automated transmission clutch packs wear and require condition assessment.

rows.text: Self-adjustment compensates for wear but does not eliminate it: a self-adjusting clutch may still need inspection or repair.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — pedal actuation, hydraulic cylinders and self-adjusting wear compensation.
https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/ — worn facings, lubricant contamination and inadequate clamping cause slip.

rows.text: An automatic clutch controls transmission engagement; it does not by itself make a vehicle more prone to rollover. On bends, speed and load stability are among the factors that matter.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_CDL_Manual_2/Section_2.aspx — curves, speed and high centre of gravity influence rollover.
https://truck.knorr-bremse.com/en/us/products/drivetrain/clutch-actuation/ — clutch connects and disconnects engine and transmission.

rows.text: When moving off, release the pedal gradually to engage the clutch without sudden jerks.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_CDL_Manual_2/Section_13.aspx §13.1.11(a) — do not abruptly release clutch.

rows.text: The oil film separates moving surfaces and carries away heat; insufficient lubrication can cause seizure.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.
https://www.ms-motorservice.com/int/en/technipedia/seizures-due-to-lack-of-lubrication-955/ — insufficient lubricant can cause seizure.

rows.text: In a wet-sump system the pump draws oil from the sump and sends it under pressure through passages to the parts requiring lubrication.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.

rows.text: The oil film reduces direct contact between moving surfaces and therefore limits wear from rubbing.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.

rows.text: A thin oil film separates moving surfaces, reducing direct contact and friction.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but does not define “natural circulation”. In forced lubrication a pump feeds oil to bearings; other lubrication methods exist, but cannot automatically be equated with the quiz term.
evidence: Official superiori question 29782 retains its printed verdict.

US military technical guide https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-M101-792426783f521896fb2b7357a6cf7ae8/pdf/GOVPUB-M101-792426783f521896fb2b7357a6cf7ae8.pdf : pump-fed lubrication; quiz term natural circulation not established as synonymous with splash or gravity.

rows.text: The injection pump belongs to the fuel supply; the oil pump is a separate component of the lubrication circuit.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure pump supplies fuel to the injection system.

rows.text: Lubrication reduces friction between moving parts by means of an oil film; its purpose is not to increase friction.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Engine Lubrication pp. 13–14 — oil film, cooling and lubricating circuit.

rows.text: High acidity does not prevent deposits. Cleanliness also depends on detergent and dispersant additives and the oil’s resistance to degradation.
evidence: https://www.exxonmobil.com/marine/-/media/files/global/us/marine/products/mobilgard-450-nc-nv0109.pdf — detergent/dispersant properties and oxidation resistance control deposits.

The PDF exceeded browser extraction limit. Patent US4445600 worm is an adjustment example, not proof of pedal-driven bearing actuation.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata è FALSO per un comando del reggispinta mediante vite senza fine; esistono dispositivi di disinnesto a vite senza fine, ma le fonti trovate non chiariscono se la formulazione limiti il quesito ai comandi a pedale dei veicoli superiori. Occorre accertare tale ambito prima di negare la possibilità in generale.
checked_sources: https://kawazmc.dk/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/Z650-B1-1976-Kawasaki-Service-Manual-1.pdf, clutch release gear wear — descrive un comando di disinnesto a vite senza fine su motocicletta; non dimostra un comando a pedale.
https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — descrive comandi idraulici e a cavo, senza escludere tutti i dispositivi a vite.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata è FALSO per circolazione forzata oppure naturale, ma la fonte tecnica documenta sistemi a gravità e a sbattimento oltre a quelli a pressione. Non è chiaro se «circolazione naturale» nel quesito indichi uno di questi sistemi o una diversa classificazione non applicabile.
checked_sources: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-M101-792426783f521896fb2b7357a6cf7ae8/pdf/GOVPUB-M101-792426783f521896fb2b7357a6cf7ae8.pdf, lubrication systems — distingue distribuzione a sbattimento, immersione, gravità e pressione; non definisce il termine italiano «circolazione naturale».
